title: JSFL: setFrameProperty missing sound frame properties (soundEffect, soundSync, soundName)
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, the setFrameProperty handler (lines 583-617) handles tweenType, label, labelName, labelType, actionScript but NOT sound properties. Flash 8 JSFL supports: setFrameProperty('soundEffect', ...), setFrameProperty('soundSync', ...), setFrameProperty('soundName', ...). The model SoundLinkage type (packages/core/src/model/types.ts) has syncMode ('event'|'start'|'stop'|'stream') and effect fields. Fix: add cases in setFrameProperty to read/set frame.sound fields: 'soundName' maps to sound.soundId or a library lookup, 'soundSync' maps to sound.syncMode, 'soundEffect' maps to sound.effect. Also add corresponding getFrameProperty support. Check how sound is structured in types.ts and the existing frame sound model.
